# Load data
```{r}
# Deblinded image counts, one row per well
results_path <- "logistic_regression/deblinded_quantified_results"

tgfbeta_dediff <- read.csv(file.path(results_path, "TGFbeta_Dediff_7d_new_results.csv"))
tgfbeta_diff_0_25 <- read.csv(file.path(results_path, "TGFbeta_Diff_0.25%_5d_results.csv"))
tgfbeta_diff <- read.csv(file.path(results_path, "TGFbeta_Diff_7d_new_results.csv"))

hypoxia_main <- read.csv(file.path(results_path, "Hypoxia_Dediff_results_main.csv"))
hypoxia_rep <- read.csv(file.path(results_path, "Hypoxia_Dediff_results_repeated.csv"))
```

# Figure 4 TGFbeta Inhibition
```{r}
# Successes and failures for the binomial models. Condition is the well ID without the plate position
tgfbeta_dediff <- tgfbeta_dediff %>%
  mutate(Condition = sub("^[^ ]+ ", "", OriginalID),       # "Plate4_D3 10%FCS + DMSO" -> "10%FCS + DMSO"
         n_MT_noEdU = n_MT - n_MT_EdU,                      # EdU-negative nuclei in myotubes
         CCR_arcsine = asin(sqrt(Perc_CCR / 100)))          # Arcsine transformation for ANOVA tests of % data

tgfbeta_diff_0_25 <- tgfbeta_diff_0_25 %>%
  mutate(n_Nuclei_no_MT = n_Nuclei - n_MT,                  # Nuclei outside myotubes
         Diff_arcsine = asin(sqrt(Diff.Index / 100)))

tgfbeta_diff <- tgfbeta_diff %>%
  mutate(Condition = sub("^[^ ]+ ", "", OriginalID),
         n_Nuclei_no_MT = n_Nuclei - n_MT,
         n_EdU_outside_MT = n_EdU - n_MT_EdU,               # EdU-positive nuclei outside myotubes
         n_noEdu_noMT = n_Nuclei - n_MT - n_EdU_outside_MT, # EdU-negative nuclei outside myotubes
         Diff_arcsine = asin(sqrt(Diff.Index / 100)))
```

# 4G Dediff CCR
```{r}
# Fig. 4G: logistic regression (binomial GLM, logit link) with EdU-positive nuclei in myotubes as successes and EdU-negative ones as failures
# Each row has to be a sample (well)
fit_tgfbeta_dediff <- glm(cbind(n_MT_EdU, n_MT_noEdU) ~ Condition, # Successes | failures ~ explain success probability with Condition
                          family = binomial,                        # Binomial likelihood with the logit (default) link
                          data = tgfbeta_dediff)

# Overall likelihood ratio test for any Condition effect: analysis of deviance (ANODEV), full model vs intercept only
# Deviance = likelihood ratio statistic, p = pchisq(Deviance, df = number of conditions - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
anova_tgfbeta_dediff <- anova(fit_tgfbeta_dediff, test = "LRT")

# Estimated CCR per Condition (prob column), pooled over the wells. type = "response" shows proportions instead of log odds
emm_tgfbeta_dediff <- emmeans(fit_tgfbeta_dediff, specs = "Condition", type = "response")

# Tukey's post hoc test (all vs all). The 0.25% FCS group stays in the model (overall test) but is excluded from the contrasts
pairs_tgfbeta_dediff <- pairs(emm_tgfbeta_dediff, exclude = "0.25%FCS", adjust = "tukey")

# Results, as in Supplementary Table 2
anova_tgfbeta_dediff
emm_tgfbeta_dediff
pairs_tgfbeta_dediff
```

# 4H Diff 0.25% TGFBi
```{r}
# Fig. 4H: differentiation index at 72h (D3) and 120h (D5), with nuclei in myotubes as successes and nuclei outside myotubes as failures
fit_tgfbeta_diff_0_25 <- glm(cbind(n_MT, n_Nuclei_no_MT) ~ Condition,
                             family = binomial,
                             data = tgfbeta_diff_0_25)

anova_tgfbeta_diff_0_25 <- anova(fit_tgfbeta_diff_0_25, test = "LRT")

emm_tgfbeta_diff_0_25 <- emmeans(fit_tgfbeta_diff_0_25, specs = "Condition", type = "response")

pairs_tgfbeta_diff_0_25 <- pairs(emm_tgfbeta_diff_0_25, adjust = "tukey") # All conditions are in 0.25% FCS, so all are compared

# Results
anova_tgfbeta_diff_0_25
emm_tgfbeta_diff_0_25
pairs_tgfbeta_diff_0_25
```

# 4I Proliferation 10%FCS
```{r}
# Fig. 4I: proliferation after 7d, with EdU-positive nuclei outside myotubes as successes and EdU-negative nuclei outside myotubes as failures
fit_tgfbeta_diff_pro <- glm(cbind(n_EdU_outside_MT, n_noEdu_noMT) ~ Condition,
                            family = binomial,
                            data = tgfbeta_diff)

anova_tgfbeta_diff_pro <- anova(fit_tgfbeta_diff_pro, test = "LRT")

emm_tgfbeta_diff_pro <- emmeans(fit_tgfbeta_diff_pro, specs = "Condition", type = "response")

pairs_tgfbeta_diff_pro <- pairs(emm_tgfbeta_diff_pro, exclude = "0.25%FCS", adjust = "tukey") # 0.25% FCS excluded from the contrasts

# Results
anova_tgfbeta_diff_pro
emm_tgfbeta_diff_pro
pairs_tgfbeta_diff_pro
```


# Figure 5 Hypoxia
```{r}
# Successes and failures for the binomial models
hypoxia_main <- hypoxia_main %>%
  mutate(n_MT_noEdU = n_MT - n_MT_EdU,                      # EdU-negative nuclei in myotubes
         n_EdU_outside_MT = n_EdU - n_MT_EdU,               # EdU-positive nuclei outside myotubes
         n_noEdu_noMT = n_Nuclei - n_MT - n_EdU_outside_MT, # EdU-negative nuclei outside myotubes
         CCR_arcsine = asin(sqrt(Perc_CCR / 100)))          # Arcsine transformation for ANOVA tests of % data

hypoxia_rep <- hypoxia_rep %>%
  mutate(n_MT_noEdU = n_MT - n_MT_EdU,
         CCR_arcsine = asin(sqrt(Perc_CCR / 100)))
```

# 5F Proliferation
```{r}
# Fig. 5F: proliferation, with EdU-positive nuclei outside myotubes as successes and EdU-negative nuclei outside myotubes as failures
fit_hypo_main_pro <- glm(cbind(n_EdU_outside_MT, n_noEdu_noMT) ~ Condition,
                         family = binomial,
                         data = hypoxia_main)

anova_hypo_main_pro <- anova(fit_hypo_main_pro, test = "LRT")

emm_hypo_main_pro <- emmeans(fit_hypo_main_pro, specs = "Condition", type = "response")

pairs_hypo_main_pro <- pairs(emm_hypo_main_pro, adjust = "tukey") # Tukey's test (all vs all)

# Results
anova_hypo_main_pro
emm_hypo_main_pro
pairs_hypo_main_pro
```
